RALF GEBERT TIMING SYSTEMS

Drag results formatter

Turn your legacy timing spreadsheet into reviewed quarter-mile results for Supabase. Your file stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded or published automatically.

1. Choose your results

Use the original two-lane export with Run, Driver1/2, React1/2, Sixty1/2, QuartT1/2 and QuartS1/2 columns. Maximum file size: 10 MB.

2. Match the event

Create the event in Supabase first, or use an existing event with no results. Keep it unpublished during import. Copy its ID, date and system here.

Validate first to see errors. If you choose to exclude them, validate again and review the exclusions. A valid result in the opposite lane is kept.

3. Review and download

Choose a file and enter the event details to begin.





4. Import and publish
  1. Use your website database in Supabase. Confirm race_results has reaction and sixty_ft.
  2. Recommended: open the SQL file in a text editor, copy it into Supabase SQL Editor and run it once. It checks the event and refuses an event that already has results.
  3. Alternatively, select race_results → Insert → Import data from CSV. Import only the CSV, not both files. CSV does not provide the SQL file’s event checks; verify the event ID and that it has no results first.
  4. Check the imported count and several timings. Set the event status to past and published to true when ready. Sign in on the website and check History.
Keep the original spreadsheet and review report as your audit record. Negative reaction times are preserved. Invalid results block export unless you explicitly choose to exclude them. Missing dates and timings are never filled with invented values. Invalid event details, worksheet structure and files containing formulas still block export.
